title: dbstack
summary: Return or display the active RunMat call stack.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side debugger introspection only; it does not inspect or move GPU buffers.

description: `dbstack` inspects RunMat's runtime call-stack context and returns MATLAB-style frame metadata.
behaviors: `dbstack` with no output displays the active stack.
`ST = dbstack` returns stack entries as an N-by-1 cell column of scalar structs because RunMat does not yet have first-class MATLAB struct arrays.
Each frame struct contains exactly the public `file`, `name`, and `line` fields; `I` is a separate second output.
`dbstack(n)` omits the first `n` returned entries; both `dbstack('-completenames', n)` and `dbstack(n, '-completenames')` additionally report full source paths when the source catalog has them.
`[ST,I] = dbstack(...)` returns the stack cell column and a current workspace index of `1` when a stack is available; more than two requested outputs reject.

faqs.question: Why is `ST` a cell column instead of a struct array?
faqs.answer: RunMat currently represents heterogeneous struct-list results as an N-by-1 cell column of scalar structs. This preserves the public frame fields and shape orientation until struct-array infrastructure lands.

gpu_behavior: `dbstack` is host-side introspection and is excluded from GPU execution and fusion.
